paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. There have been 2 new news items in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include "Fermi Says It Received US Subpoena Tied to Project Matador" and "Fermi Says It Received US Subpoena Related to Project Matador", both from Bloomberg sources, indicating the company received a subpoena related to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas.

There have been various SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary and target annual bonus.
